# Anki compatibility fixture content

The synthetic card text, field values, template strings, CSS, generated tone
samples, and scheduling/review values in `japanesePackage()`,
`templateMediaPackage()`, and `imageOcclusionPackage()` in
`src/anki-import.test.ts`, along with the fixture data in
`image-occlusion-rectangles.json`, are dedicated to the public domain under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).

These fixtures contain no third-party deck text, user collection data, or
upstream Anki package. The image-occlusion example records attribution to the
upstream shape format it models; its example values and wording were written for
this project. The CC0 dedication applies to fixture content only, not test
source code, Anki software, or third-party dependencies. The official-engine
package remains ephemeral because its serialized stock defaults have unresolved
redistribution terms; see `docs/research/anki-package-fixture-provenance.md`.
